ownerStatement: "I approve 0.4.1" (25 November 2026), after the Windows 11 unit records of 24 and 25 November, and, asked the same day how to document its unchanged Octatrack pages, "Keep 0.4.0's": USB Audio 0.4.1-experimental with the adaptive input endpoint, without the full test procedure on this exact build, with the same two resource exceptions as 0.3.0 and 0.4.0, and with 0.4.0's OT UI captures (its SETTINGS, USB AUDIO and INPUTS pages are unchanged).
reason: With INPUTS on, 0.4.0 declared EP3 OUT asynchronous with implicit feedback, which Windows' usbaudio2 does not support (Code 10, reported on Windows 10 and reproduced on Windows 11 on 25 November). 0.4.1 declares it adaptive and absorbs the drift on the unit. On the owner's Octatrack MKII, base 0.8.1 e11525835106, Windows 11: INPUTS AB played 240 s (58.1 ppm absorbed) and INPUTS ABCD 60 s (56.4 ppm absorbed), no underrun; four Undos, three reconnected and one (24 November, kept set loaded) left USB until a power cycle. Not run: the soak, the price and frame cost, Keep and a power cycle, INPUTS CD, Windows 10, macOS, Linux. Worst-case ColdFire cycles and the complete memory bound including stack and DMA remain unmeasured, as for 0.3.0 and 0.4.0.
